explain._other: KiCad flags this item. Open the board in KiCad at the place shown to see what it means.
explain.clearance: Two copper items are closer than the rules allow. The maker cannot etch them apart, and they may touch.
explain.unconnected_items: A connection drawn in the schematic has no track on the board yet.
explain.track_width: A track is thinner than the rules allow. It may break or carry too little current.
explain.hole_clearance: A hole is too close to copper. The drill may cut into it.
explain.copper_edge_clearance: Copper is too close to the board edge. Cutting the board may expose or cut it.
explain.courtyards_overlap: Two parts claim the same space. They may not both fit when assembled.
explain.silk_overlap: Two printed texts or drawings overlap and will be hard to read.
explain.silk_over_copper: Printed ink lies on a pad. The maker usually clips it.
explain.solder_mask_bridge: Solder mask is missing between two pads. Solder may bridge them.
explain.annular_width: The copper ring around a hole is too thin. The hole may break out of it.
explain.drill_out_of_range: A hole is smaller or larger than the rules allow.
explain.hole_to_hole: Two holes are too close. The board between them may crack.
explain.invalid_outline: The board outline is not a closed shape. The maker cannot cut it.
explain.isolated_copper: A copper area is connected to nothing. It is usually useless.
explain.starved_thermal: A pad in a copper zone has too few spokes. It may not be connected well.
explain.track_dangling: A track ends in the void, connected to nothing at one end.
explain.via_dangling: A via connects to nothing, or to one layer only.
explain.lib_footprint_issues: KiCad cannot find this part's footprint library on this computer. The board is fine; the link to the library is not.
explain.lib_footprint_mismatch: This footprint differs from the one in its library.
explain.missing_footprint: A part of the schematic is missing from the board.
explain.extra_footprint: A part on the board is not in the schematic.
explain.duplicate_footprints: Two parts on the board have the same reference.
explain.net_conflict: A pad's connection on the board differs from the schematic.
explain.shorting_items: Two different nets touch: this is a short circuit.
explain.pin_not_connected: A pin of a part is connected to nothing. Mark it « not connected » if that is intended.
explain.pin_not_driven: An input pin receives no signal from any output.
explain.power_pin_not_driven: A power pin is connected to nothing that supplies power. Add a power flag if the supply comes from a connector.
explain.label_dangling: A label is attached to no wire.
explain.wire_dangling: A wire ends in the void.
explain.pin_to_pin: Two pins that should not be joined are connected, for example two outputs.
explain.unannotated: A part has no number yet (R?). Annotate the schematic.
explain.duplicate_reference: Two parts of the schematic have the same reference.
explain.lib_symbol_issues: KiCad cannot find this symbol's library on this computer.
explain.multiple_net_names: One wire carries two different names.
explain.global_label_dangling: A global label is attached to no wire.
explain.endpoint_off_grid: A wire or pin end is off the grid. It may look connected and not be.
explain.footprint_link_issues: The footprint chosen for a symbol cannot be found.
explain.text_thickness: A text line is too thin for the board maker to print.
explain.text_height: A text is too small for the board maker to print.
explain.silk_edge_clearance: Printed ink is too close to the board edge. It may be cut off.
explain.holes_co_located: Two holes are at the same place. One of them is probably a mistake.
